name: BusinessKycAssessment
description: Company-level KYC/CDD assessment record produced by SVC-014 (KYC/AML Service) in BPH-005. Extends the KycAssessment pattern (ENT-003) for legal entities: company-level PEP/sanctions/adverse media screening, sector risk assessment, jurisdictional risk, aggregated UBO/director individual screening results, and composite risk scoring. The MLRO (PER-052) holds accountability for this assessment under MLR 2017 SMF17. This is the bank's primary audit record for MLR 2017 Regulation 28 compliance for each business customer. Note: BusinessKycAssessment is a SEPARATE entity from ENT-003 (KycAssessment) — they share a conceptual pattern but are not a subtype/supertype. Each evolves independently per its capability domain.

fields.name: business_customer_id
fields.validation_rule: Required. Cross-service reference to BusinessCustomer.business_customer_id (not a DB FK — resolved via event payload). Immutable.

fields.name: company_sanctions_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: status (enum: clear | blocked | pending_review), match_detail (string, null if clear), lists_checked (array: OFSI | OFAC | UN | EU), screened_at (timestamp). Hard limit: 3,000ms (GOV-005-R02).

fields.name: company_pep_screening_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: status (enum: clear | match | pending_review), match_detail (string, null if clear), data_source (string), screened_at (timestamp). Screens the company for PEP-linked entities.

fields.name: company_adverse_media_result
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: status (enum: clear | flagged | pending_review), summary (string, null if clear), severity (enum: none | low | medium | high), screened_at (timestamp).

fields.name: sector_risk_assessment
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: sic_code_risk_tier (enum: low | medium | high | prohibited), sector_notes (string, nullable), prohibited_sector (boolean). Prohibited sectors result in automatic decline.

fields.name: jurisdictional_risk
fields.validation_rule: Required. Object: country_of_incorporation_risk (enum: low | medium | high), operating_countries (array of ISO 3166-1 alpha-2), high_risk_jurisdiction_flag (boolean — true if any country on FATF grey/black list or HM Treasury designated list).

fields.name: ubo_individual_assessments
fields.validation_rule: Required. Array of summary screening results per UBO. Each: ubo_id (UUID), pep_status (enum), sanctions_status (enum), adverse_media_status (enum), individual_risk_contribution (enum: low | medium | high).

fields.name: director_individual_assessments
fields.validation_rule: Required. Same structure as ubo_individual_assessments but for directors not already in ubo_individual_assessments.

fields.name: risk_score
fields.validation_rule: Required. 0–100. Composite score: company-level findings + individual UBO/director findings. Bands: 0–30 = standard; 31–60 = standard_elevated; 61–100 = enhanced (EDD required).
fields.transparency_note: Not surfaced to PER-002 or PER-050. MLRO-only.

fields.name: risk_category
fields.validation_rule: Required. Enum: standard | standard_elevated | enhanced. 'enhanced' maps to EDD required (AP-B001). MLR 2017 Regulation 33 compliance.

fields.name: edd_required
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. Set to true when risk_category = enhanced, any UBO/director pep_status = match, or high_risk_jurisdiction_flag = true.

fields.name: edd_trigger_reasons
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when edd_required = true. Enum values: pep_director | pep_ubo | high_risk_jurisdiction | complex_structure | elevated_risk_score | sector_risk_high.

fields.name: assessment_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD). Date CDD assessment completed.

fields.name: next_review_date
fields.validation_rule: Required. Calculated: standard = +3 years; standard_elevated = +2 years; enhanced = +1 year. Drives pKYC scheduling.

fields.name: mlro_referral
fields.validation_rule: Required. Default: false. True when EDD required or manual MLRO review triggered.

fields.name: mlro_sign_off_by
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when mlro_referral = true and outcome = cleared. FK → Staff.staff_id for PER-052.

fields.name: mlro_sign_off_at
fields.validation_rule: Conditional. Required when mlro_sign_off_by populated. ISO 8601 UTC. Immutable.

relationships.description: BusinessKycAssessment belongs to one BusinessCustomer (cross-service reference via business_customer_id).

design_decisions.decision: BusinessKycAssessment is owned by SVC-014, not SVC-005, even though UBO/Director records are owned by SVC-005.
design_decisions.rationale: MLRO accountability under POCA 2002 and MLR 2017 requires the CDD assessment to sit in a single system of record under MLRO governance. SVC-014 is that system. Individual assessment summaries are included by value (not by FK) to avoid cross-service reads.

design_decisions.decision: BusinessKycAssessment is separate from ENT-003 (KycAssessment). They share a pattern but are not a subtype relationship.
design_decisions.rationale: Corporate CDD has materially different fields (sector risk, jurisdictional risk, UBO assessments, EDD triggers) from individual CDD. Subtyping would couple CAP-001 and CAP-002 at the schema level. Separate entities allow independent evolution.
